EARLY LIFE OF DAVID ROBERTS

til was brought up in the midst of great poverty. The wages of the common la-. 
borer Was my father's wage, which, for many years was from one shilling to one shill­
i'ng and six pence in a day and board himself which, usually was not enough to get

"I was very sick with fever when I waS ten or eleven years old and soon after
